filter-column-age-hint: Qari kaararka galay liiskan in ka badan tiradan maalmood ka hor. Liisaska kale iyo kaararka aan la garanayn taariikhda ay galeen way muuqanayaan. Wax ka beddelidda kaarka dib uma bilowdo muddada uu ku jiray liiska.

advanced-filter-card-dates-hint: Taariikhaha kaararka ku shaandhee @createdAt, @receivedAt, @startAt, @dueAt, @endAt ama @listEnteredAt. Tusaale: @endAt >= '2026-01-01' ama @endAt = none. Magaca goob gaar ah oo ku bilaabma @ ku dhex qor calaamadaha xigashada.
advanced-filter-description: Shaandhaynta Horumarsan waxay kuu oggolaanaysaa inaad qorto xarig ka kooban hawlwadeennadan: == != <= >= && || ( ) Boos ayaa kala saara Hawlwadeennada. Waxaad dhammaan Goobaha Gaarka ah ku shaandhayn kartaa adigoo qoraya magacyadooda iyo qiimayaashooda. Tusaale: Field1 == Value1. Ogow: Haddii goobaha ama qiimayaashu ay leeyihiin boosas, waa inaad ku wareejisaa hal calaamadood oo xigasho. Tusaale: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Si looga boodo hal calaamadood oo xakameyn ah (' \/), waxaad adeegsan kartaa \. Tusaale: Field1 == I\'m. Waxaad sidoo kale isku dari kartaa shuruudo badan. Tusaale: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Caadi ahaan dhammaan hawlwadeennada waxaa loo fasiraa bidix ilaa midig. Waxaad kala hormarinta ku beddeli kartaa adigoo dhigaya qawsas. Tusaale: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Waxaad sidoo kale goobaha qoraalka ku raadin kartaa regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i

import-board-instruction-kanboard: Ku dheji JSON dhoofinta Kanboard: walax leh "columns" (ama hawlo sida column_name u sida) iyo saf "tasks" ah (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Columns waxay noqdaan liisas, tasks-na waxay noqdaan kaarar.
import-board-instruction-deck: Ku dheji JSON sabuurad NextCloud Deck ah (sabuurad leh "stacks", stack kastaana sida "cards"). Stacks waxay noqdaan liisas, cards-na waxay noqdaan kaarar.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Ku dheji ururinta work-packages JSON ee OpenProject (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Statuses waxay noqdaan liisas, work packages-na waxay noqdaan kaarar.
import-board-instruction-issues: Ku dheji safka JSON ee arrimaha __sourceName__ (__endpoint__). Arrimuhu waxay noqdaan kaarar loo ururiyay liisaska Open / Closed.
import-board-instruction-asana: Ku dheji dhoofinta hawlaha Asana ee JSON ({ "data": [...] } oo ka timid dhoofinta Asana ama GET /tasks). Hawlaha waxaa loo ururiyaa qaybo (memberships); hawlaha dhammaystiran waxay tagaan Done.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Ku dheji dhoofinta liiska ZenKit ee JSON ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Stages waxay noqdaan liisas, items-na waxay noqdaan kaarar.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Ku dheji liiska hawlaha markdown (heshiiska ay isticmaalaan qalabka markdown-kanban sida Obsidian Kanban): cinwaanka "## Magaca liiska", oo leh walxo "- [ ]"/"- [x]" hoosta ka yaal. Cinwaannadu waxay noqdaan liisas walxuhuna waxay noqdaan kaararka.
import-board-instruction-leo: Ku dheji qaab-dhismeed Leo ah (fayl .leo ah). Qaybaha heerka ugu sarreeya waxay noqdaan liisas, qaybaha si toos ah uga hoos baxana waxay noqdaan kaarar iyadoo qoraalka qaybtu yahay sharraxaadda kaarka. Qaybaha heerarka ka sii hooseeya waxay noqdaan liisas hubin. Qaybaha calaamadaysan waxaa loo soo dejiyaa kuwo la dhammaystiray.
import-board-instruction-opml: Dhaji qorshe OPML ah, sida ay u soo saaraan Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq iyo qalabka kale ee qorshaynta. Walxaha heerka sare waxay noqdaan liisas, carruurtooda waxay noqdaan kaarar oo qoraalku yahay sharaxaadda, walxaha ka hooseeyana waxay noqdaan liisas hubin. Walxaha la dhammeeyay waxaa loo soo dejiyaa sidii la qabtay.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Dhaji fayl Org mode ah, sida ay u qoraan Emacs, Orgzly ama Beorg. Cinwaanada heerka sare waxay noqdaan liisas, cinwaanada heerka labaadna waxay noqdaan kaarar. TODO iyo DONE, mudnaanta, summadaha, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE iyo CLOSED waa la hayaa, sanduuqyada calaamadeynta iyo cinwaanada ka hooseeyana waxay noqdaan liisas hubin.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Ku dheji faylka todo.txt: hal hawl sadar kasta, sida ay u qoraan abka todo.txt iyo ababka la jaanqaada. Hawlaha dhammaaday ("x") waxay galaan Done, +project iyo @context waxay noqdaan summado, (A) wuxuu noqdaa summad mudnaan, due: iyo t: na waxay kala noqdaan taariikhda kama dambaysta ah iyo taariikhda bilowga.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Ku dheji natiijada task export: taxane JSON ah ama hal hawl sadar kasta. Hawlaha dhammaaday waxay tagaan Done, project iyo priority waxay noqdaan calaamado, annotations waxay noqotaa faallooyin, depends-na waxay noqotaa ku-tiirsanaanta hawlaha xannibaya.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Ka fur faylka .boardarchive isku-ururinta oo ku dheji waxa ku jira board.jsonl ee looxa, iyadoo sadarka noocu jiro ama uusan jirin. Sifada kooxaynta ee muuqaalka looxu waxay noqotaa liisas, sifooyinka kale ee xulashadu waxay noqdaan calaamado, qaybaha qoraalka iyo sanduuqyada calaamadintu waxay noqdaan sharaxaad iyo liiska hubinta, faallooyinkana waa la hayaa. Sawirrada iyo lifaaqyada lama soo dejiyo.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-azuredevops: Gudaha Azure DevOps, fur Boards, kadib Queries, socodsii weydiin muujinaysa tiirarka aad rabto, oo dooro Export to CSV; kadib dooro faylkaas .csv. Board Column (ama State) waxay noqotaa liisaska, Board Lane-na waddooyinka; walxaha shaqadu waxay noqdaan kaarar leh noocooda iyo tags sida calaamado, Assigned To, taariikho, sharraxaad iyo waalid, tiirarka kalena waxay noqdaan goobo gaar ah.
import-board-instruction-mslists: Gudaha Microsoft Lists, fur liiska, dooro Export, kadib Export to CSV, oo dooro faylkaas .csv. Tiirka Status (ama Progress) wuxuu noqdaa liisaska, shay kastaana kaar, oo leh cinwaankiisa, sharraxaadda, dadka, taariikhaha iyo tags; tiirarka kale waxay noqdaan goobo gaar ah.
import-board-instruction-msproject: Gudaha Microsoft Project, dooro File, kadib Save As, nooca XML Format (*.xml), oo dooro faylkaas. Hawlaha soo koobidda waxay noqdaan waddooyin, hawlahuna waxay noqdaan kaarar ku jira Not started, In progress ama Completed, oo leh taariikhahooda, qoraallada, ilaha, hawlaha hoose iyo kuwa ka horreeya.
import-board-instruction-outlook: Gudaha Outlook, u jiid fariimaha gal ku yaal kombiyuutarkaaga, ama ku kaydi File, kadib Save As, sida Outlook Message Format (*.msg). Dooro hal fayl .msg, ama .zip ka kooban faylal .msg iyo .eml. Wadahadal kastaa wuxuu noqdaa kaar ku jira Board View / Email, jawaabahiisu waxay noqdaan faallooyin, lifaaqyadiisuna faylal.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: MeisterTask gudihiisa, guji magaca mashruuca, dooro Export project oo soo saar CSV, kadibna dhaji. Qaybaha waxay noqdaan liisas, hawlahana waxay noqdaan kaarar, iyagoo leh qoraalladooda, taariikhda ugu dambeysa, qofka loo xilsaaray iyo summadaha; hawlaha la dhammeeyay waxay hayaan taariikhda la dhammeeyay. CSV loo qoray soo dejinta MeisterTask laftiisa sidoo kale waa shaqeysaa.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: Obsidian gudihiisa, u fur faylka sabuuradda Kanban sidii Markdown (ama ku fur faylka .md tifaftire qoraal), kadibna dhaji dhammaan. Waddooyinku waxay noqdaan liisas leh xadka kaararkooda, kaararku waxay hayaan summadahooda, taariikhaha, mudnaanta, goobaha iyo liiska hubinta, Archive-kuna wuxuu noqdaa kaarar la kaydiyay.
import-board-instruction-linear: Linear gudihiisa, soo saar arrimaha sidii CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, ama soo saarista muuqaal), kadibna dhaji CSV-ga. Xaaladaha waxay noqdaan liisas, kooxaha waxay noqdaan waddooyin, arrimahana waxay noqdaan kaarar leh qofka loo xilsaaray, calaamadaha, taariikhaha, arrinta waalidka, mudnaanta, qiyaasta, mashruuca iyo wareegga.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: TickTick gudihiisa, fur Settings, Account, Backup & Import oo samee nuqul kayd ah, kadibna dhaji faylka CSV. Liis kasta oo TickTick ah wuxuu noqdaa waddo, tiirarkiisuna waxay noqdaan liisas; hawluhu waxay hayaan summadahooda, taariikhaha, liiska hubinta, mudnaanta iyo hawlaha hoose.
import-board-instruction-clickup: ClickUp gudihiisa, soo saar hawlaha sidii CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, ama soo saarista muuqaal List ama Table oo leh dhammaan tiirarka), kadibna dhaji CSV-ga. Xaaladaha waxay noqdaan liisas, liisaska ClickUp waxay noqdaan waddooyin, hawlahana waxay noqdaan kaarar leh hawlahooda hoose, dadka loo xilsaaray, summadaha, taariikhaha, mudnaanta iyo waqtiga.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: Nullboard gudihiisa, fur sabuuradda, ka dooro menu-ga Export this board..., ku fur faylka .nbx tifaftire qoraal oo dhaji waxa ku jira. Liisasku waxay noqdaan liisas, qoraalladuna waxay noqdaan kaarar: sadarka koowaad ee qoraalka waa cinwaanka kaarka, inta kalena waa sharaxaaddiisa. Qoraal raw ah wuxuu helaa calaamadda raw. Fayl leh sabuuradro badan wuxuu soo dejiyaa sabuuradda koowaad.
import-board-instruction-kanri: Kanri gudihiisa, fur Import & Export oo dooro Export individual board (ama Export all data), kadibna dhaji faylka .json. Tiirarku waxay noqdaan liisas, kaararkuna waxay noqdaan kaarar, iyagoo leh sharaxaaddooda, taariikhda ugu dambeysa, summadaha iyo midabada; hawlaha kaarku waxay noqdaan liis hubin. Soo saarista dhammaan xogta, sabuuradda koowaad ayaa la soo dejiyaa.
import-board-instruction-planka: Qor cinwaanka Planka-gaaga (tusaale https://planka.example.com), magaca isticmaalaha iyo furaha sirta ee Planka, kadibna riix «Muuji waxa la soo dejin karo». Waxaa loo isticmaalaa oo kaliya in la keeno looxa, lamana kaydiyo. Dooro loox oo riix «Keen»: WeKan waxay ka akhrisaa API-ga Planka iyadoo la socota liisaskiisa, kaararkiisa, sharaxaadaha, taariikhaha kama dambaysta ah, calaamadaha, xubnaha, liisaska hawlaha iyo faallooyinka, kadibna sii wad soo dejinta sidii caadiga ahayd. Kaararka ku jira kaydka Planka waxaa loo soo dejiyaa sidii la kaydiyay; lifaaqyada iyo kaararka ku jira qashinka lama soo dejiyo.
import-board-instruction-mstodo: Gudaha Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer), gal, oggolow ogolaanshaha Tasks.Read oo koobi token-ka tab-ka Access token. Halkan ku dheji oo riix «Muuji waxa la soo dejin karo»; token-ka waxaa loo isticmaalaa keenistan oo kaliya, lamana kaydiyo. Dooro dhammaan liisaska ama mid oo riix «Keen». Liis kasta oo To Do ah wuxuu noqdaa liis, hawl kastana kaar, iyadoo leh qoraallo, taariikhaha kama dambaysta iyo bilowga, tallaabooyinka sidii liiska hubinta, qaybaha sidii calaamado, muhiimad sare iyo xaaladda sidii calaamado; hawlaha la dhammeeyay waa la kaydiyaa. Xasuusinta iyo ku celcelinta lama soo dejiyo.
import-board-instruction-onenote: Gudaha Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer), gal, ogolow ogolaanshaha Notes.Read oo koobiyee token-ka tabka Access token. Halkan ku dheji oo guji «Muuji waxa la soo dejin karo»; token-ka waxaa loo isticmaalaa keenistan oo keliya lamana kaydiyo. Dooro buug qoraal oo guji «Keen». Qaybaha waxay noqdaan liisas, boggaguna kaarar, oo leh qoraalkooda, sanduuqyada hawlaha la qabanayo sida liiska hubinta iyo bogagga hoose sida hawlaha hoose.
import-board-instruction-teams: Dheji token gelitaan Microsoft Graph oo leh Chat.Read (ka yimid Graph Explorer, akoon shaqo ama dugsi) oo guji «Muuji waxa la soo dejin karo», kadib dooro sheeko ama kanaal oo guji «Keen»; token-ka lama kaydiyo. Ama dooro fayl: .tar-ka dhoofintaada shakhsiga ah ee teams.live.com/dataexport, ama .json ka kooban fariimaha sheekada. Sheeko kastaa waxay noqotaa kaar ku jira Board View / Chat, fariimaheeduna faallooyinka.
import-board-instruction-sandstorm: Sandstorm gudihiisa, fur grain-ka __app__, ka dooro "Download backup" baarka sare ee grain-ka, oo dooro faylkaas .zip. Waxa ku jira grain-ku waxay noqdaan sabuurad, alaabtiisuna kaarar ay la socdaan waxa uu barnaamijku ka hayo. Dooro barnaamijka uu grain-ku leeyahay: grain barnaamij kale waa la diidaa, wuxuuna sheegaa barnaamijka uu yahay.
import-board-instruction-kanbanflow: Gudaha KanbanFlow, fur menu-ga looxa, dooro Settings → API & Webhooks oo koobi token-ka API ee looxa. Halkan ku dheji token-ka, riix «Muuji waxa la soo dejin karo», dooro looxa oo riix «Keen»; token-ka waxaa loo isticmaalaa keenistaas oo kaliya, lamana kaydiyo. Tiirarku waxay noqdaan liisas, waddooyinkuna waddooyin ayay ahaadaan; hawluhu waxay hayaan sharaxaaddooda, midabka, calaamadaha, taariikhda kama dambaysta ah, hawl-hoosaadyada sidii liiska hubinta, waqtiga la isticmaalay, qiyaasta, dadka iyo faallooyinka.
import-board-instruction-basecamp: Qor ID-ga koontada Basecamp (lambarka ka dambeeya basecamp.com/ ee cinwaanka) iyo token gelitaan (laga helay app OAuth 2 oo ka diiwaangashan launchpad.37signals.com, ama mid isku-xir jira horey u haysto), riix «Muuji waxa la soo dejin karo», dooro mashruuc oo riix «Keen». Token-ka waxaa loo isticmaalaa keenistaas oo kaliya, lamana kaydiyo. Miis kaar kasta wuxuu noqdaa waddo leh tiirarkiisa sidii liisas, liisaska waxyaabaha la qabanayana waxay noqdaan waddo «To-dos»; kaararka iyo waxyaabaha la qabanayo waxay hayaan qoraalkooda, taariikhaha, dadka loo xilsaaray iyo faallooyinka, tallaabooyinka kaarku waxay noqdaan liiska hubinta, kuwa la dhammeeyayna waa la kaydiyaa.
import-board-instruction-googletasks: Ka hel token gelitaan OAuth 2.0 Playground: hoosta Tasks API v1 dooro tasks.readonly, riix Authorize APIs, kadib Exchange authorization code for tokens, oo koobi token-ka gelitaanka. Halkan ku dheji oo riix «Muuji waxa la soo dejin karo», dooro dhammaan liisaska hawlaha ama mid, kadib «Keen». Token-ka waxaa loo isticmaalaa keenistan oo kaliya, lamana kaydiyo. Liisaska hawluhu waxay noqdaan liisas, hawluhuna kaarar, iyagoo leh qoraallo, xiriiriyeyaal iyo taariikh kama dambays ah; hawl-hoosaadyadu waxay noqdaan liiska hubinta, hawlaha la dhammeeyayna waxaa loo soo dejiyaa sidii la kaydiyay.
import-board-instruction-googlekeep: API-ga Google Keep waxaa loogu talagalay koontooyinka Google Workspace oo kaliya. Hel token gelitaan OAuth 2.0 oo leh baaxadda https://www.googleapis.com/auth/keep.readonly (gudaha OAuth 2.0 Playground haddii maamulaha Workspace-kaagu oggolaado, ama koonto adeeg oo leh wakaalad domain-ka oo dhan), dheji, riix «Muuji waxa la soo dejin karo» kadibna «Keen». Token-ka waxaa loo isticmaalaa keenistan oo kaliya, lamana kaydiyo. Qoraallada qoraalka ahi waxay noqdaan kaarar ku jira liiska «Notes», qoraallada liiska hubintuna waxay noqdaan kaarar ku jira liiska «Lists» iyagoo walxahoodu yihiin liiska hubinta. Qoraallada qashinka ku jira, lifaaqyada iyo wadaagistu lama soo dejiyo.
api-import-desc: Ka keen adeegga adigoo isticmaalaya koontadaada. Waxa aad halkan ku qorto waxaa loo isticmaalaa keenistan oo kaliya, lamana kaydiyo.
api-import-list: Muuji waxa la soo dejin karo
api-import-fetched: Waa la keenay. Hubi xubnaha hoose oo soo deji.
api-import-nothing: Ma jiro wax la soo dejiyo oo koontadan ah.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: Pivotal Tracker gudihiisa, fur tab-ka MORE ee mashruuca oo dooro Export CSV (ama dooro sheekooyin oo dooro Bulk Actions, CSV), kadibna dhaji CSV-ga. Xaalad kasta oo sheeko waxay noqotaa liis, sheekooyinkuna waxay noqdaan kaarar, iyagoo leh noocooda iyo calaamadahooda, milkiilayaasha, codsadaha, taariikhaha, faallooyinka, hawlaha iyo caqabadaha; Estimate wuxuu noqdaa Story points, wareegyaduna waxay noqdaan sprint-yo.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: Tasks.org gudihiisa, fur Settings, Backups oo dooro Export tasks, kadibna dhaji waxa ku jira faylkaas .json. Liisasku waxay noqdaan liisas, hawluhuna waxay noqdaan kaarar, iyagoo leh qoraalladooda, summadaha, taariikhaha, faallooyinka iyo hawlaha hoose; hawlaha la dhammeeyay waxay hayaan taariikhda la dhammeeyay, mudnaantuna waxay noqotaa goob gaar ah.
import-board-instruction-monday: monday.com gudihiisa, fur menu-ga sabuuradda, dooro More actions iyo Export board to Excel (haddii aad rabto, la socda cusboonaysiinta iyo walxaha hoose), kadibna dooro faylkaas .xlsx. Tiirka Status wuxuu noqdaa liisas, kooxuhuna waxay noqdaan waddooyin; dadka, taariikhaha, jadwalka iyo summadaha meeshooda ayay ku hadhaan, tiirarka kalena waxay noqdaan goobo gaar ah, cusboonaysiintuna waxay noqotaa faallooyin.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: Super Productivity gudihiisa, fur Settings, kadib Sync & Backup, dooro Export Data oo dhaji waxa ku jira faylka sp-backup .json. Mashruuc kasta wuxuu noqdaa waddo, hawluhuna waxay noqdaan kaarar ku jira To Do, In Progress, Backlog ama Done, iyagoo leh qoraalladooda, summadaha, taariikhda ugu dambeysa, waqtiga la isticmaalay iyo hawlaha hoose; hawlaha la kaydiyay waxay noqdaan kaarar la kaydiyay.
import-board-instruction-taiga: Taiga gudihiisa, fur Admin > Project > Export oo soo deji kaydka mashruuca (marka hore kala fur faylka .json.gz), kadibna dhaji JSON-kiisa. Xaaladaha sheekooyinka isticmaalaha waxay noqdaan liisas, sheekooyinka isticmaalahana waxay noqdaan kaarar leh hawlahooda sidii hawlo hoose, epics iyo arrimaha waxay helaan waddooyin u gaar ah, sprint-yada, summadaha, faallooyinka iyo sifooyinka gaarka ahna way la socdaan. Lifaaqyada lama soo dejiyo.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: Vikunja gudihiisa, fur Settings, dooro Data Export oo soo deji faylka .zip ee ay kuu soo dirto, kadibna dooro faylkaas, ama dhaji data.json ku jira. Baaldiyada Kanban waxay noqdaan liisas, hawluhuna waxay noqdaan kaarar, iyagoo leh calaamadahooda, dadka loo xilsaaray, taariikhaha, sharaxaadda, liisaska hawlaha sidii liisas hubin iyo faallooyinka; mudnaanta, boqolkiiba la qabtay iyo la qabtay waxay noqdaan goobo gaar ah. Lifaaqyada lama soo dejiyo.
import-board-instruction-quire: Quire gudihiisa, fur menu-ga mashruuca oo dooro Export CSV, kadibna dhaji CSV-ga. Xaaladaha waxay noqdaan liisas, hawluhuna waxay noqdaan kaarar, iyagoo leh hawlahooda hoose sidii kaarar carruur ah, dadka loo xilsaaray, summadaha sidii calaamado, taariikhaha bilowga, ugu dambeynta iyo dhammaystirka, sharaxaadda iyo mudnaanta sidii goob gaar ah. Faallooyinka iyo lifaaqyada kuma jiraan CSV-ga Quire.
import-board-instruction-wrike: Wrike gudihiisa, u soo saar mashruuc ama gal Excel, ama buuxi qaabka soo dejinta Excel ee Wrike, kadibna dooro faylkaas .xlsx. Safafka galka iyo mashruuca waxay noqdaan waddooyin, Status wuxuu noqdaa liisas, hawluhuna waxay noqdaan kaarar, iyagoo leh Key-gooda, hawsha waalidka, dadka loo xilsaaray, taariikhaha bilowga iyo dhammaadka, ku-tiirsanaanta iyo sharaxaadda; Priority, Duration iyo tiirarka kale waxay noqdaan goobo gaar ah.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: Teamwork.com gudihiisa, buuxi qaabka soo dejinta hawlaha Excel (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) oo u kaydi sidii .xlsx, kadibna dooro faylkaas. Liisaska hawlaha waxay noqdaan liisas, hawluhuna waxay noqdaan kaarar; hawl ku bilaabata -, # ama > waxay noqotaa hawl hoose oo ka mid ah hawsha ka sarreysa (--, ## ama >> hal heer oo ka hooseeya). Dadka loo xilsaaray, taariikhaha iyo summadaha meeshooda ayay ku hadhaan; Priority, Estimated time iyo Complete waxay noqdaan goobo gaar ah.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: Businessmap (hore Kanbanize) gudihiisa, fur Advanced Search, dooro Configure results si aad u doorato tiirarka, soo deji faylka Excel, kadibna dooro faylkaas .xlsx. Tiirarka waxaa lagu akhriyaa magacyadooda Ingiriisiga (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): haddii akoonkaagu isticmaalo luqad kale, marka hore u beddel safka cinwaanka Ingiriisi. Column wuxuu noqdaa liisas, Lane-na waddooyin; milkiilayaasha, summadaha, midabka, taariikhaha, faallooyinka iyo xiriiriyeyaasha waalidka meeshooda ayay ku hadhaan, Priority, Size, Type iyo tiirarka kalena waxay noqdaan goobo gaar ah.
import-board-instruction-redmine: Redmine gudihiisa, fur Issues-ka mashruuca, dooro Also available in: CSV ee hoose ee liiska, dooro tiirarka (All columns, oo leh Description) oo soo saar, kadibna dhaji CSV-ga. Redmine wuxuu tiirarka ugu magac daraa luqaddaada, sidaa darteed ka hor soo saarista u deji luqaddaada Ingiriisi My account gudihiisa. Xaalad kasta waxay noqotaa liis, arrimahuna waxay noqdaan kaarar, iyagoo leh tracker-ka sidii calaamad, qofka loo xilsaaray, qoraaga, taariikhaha, hawsha waalidka iyo arrimaha la xiriira; mudnaanta, qaybta, nooca la beegsanayo, waqtiga la qiyaasay, % Done iyo goobaha gaarka ah waxay noqdaan goobo gaar ah.
import-board-instruction-notion: Notion gudihiisa, u fur xogta sidii bog buuxa, dooro ••• iyo Export, dooro Markdown & CSV, oo dooro faylka .zip ee la soo dejiyo, ama hal CSV xog ah oo ka mid ah, ama dhaji CSV-gaas. Tiir la yiraahdo Status wuxuu noqdaa liisas (haddii uusan jirin, tiirka koowaad ee u eg doorasho ayaa noqda, warbixinta soo dejintuna way sheegtaa kan); safafku waxay noqdaan kaarar leh cinwaankooda, summadaha sidii calaamado, dadka sidii xubno, taariikhaha, iyo qoraalka bogga sidii sharaxaad; tiirarka kale waxay noqdaan goobo gaar ah. Xiriirada, sawirada iyo lifaaqyada lama soo dejiyo.
import-board-instruction-plane: Plane gudihiisa, fur Workspace Settings, dooro Exports, u soo saar mashaariicda sidii JSON, CSV ama Excel oo soo deji faylka .zip, kadibna dooro faylkaas, ama hal fayl oo ku dhex jira, ama dhaji JSON-ka ama CSV-ga. Xaaladaha waxay noqdaan liisas, mashaariicdu waxay noqdaan waddooyin, arrimahuna waxay noqdaan kaarar leh aqoonsigooda, waalidka, dadka loo xilsaaray, calaamadaha, taariikhaha, xiriiriyeyaasha iyo faallooyinka; mudnaanta, qiyaasta, wareegga iyo moduul-ka waxay noqdaan goobo gaar ah. Soo saarista Plane ma laha sharaxaado ama lifaaqyo, sidaa darteed lama soo dejiyo.
import-board-instruction-fizzy: Fizzy gudihiisa, ka dhoofi akoonka "Account settings", ama kaararkaaga gaarka ah adigoo isticmaalaya "Download my data", oo dooro faylka .zip ee Fizzy kuu soo diro, ama faylka .json ee hal kaar. Sabuuraduhu waxay noqdaan waddooyin, tiirarkuna waxay noqdaan liisas, oo leh "Maybe?", "Not now" iyo "Done" sida Fizzy; kaararku waxay hayaan sharaxaaddooda, calaamadaha, kuwa loo xilsaaray, tallaabooyinka oo liiska hubinta ah, faallooyinka iyo faylasha.
import-board-instruction-mail: Dooro fayl .mbox ah, sida Thunderbird, Apple Mail, mutt ama Gmail iyagoo maraya Google Takeout u kaydiyaan, ama hal fariin .eml ah, ama dhaji qoraalkeeda. Wada-hadal kastaa wuxuu noqdaa hal kaar oo ku jira liiska Inbox, oo leh diraha, qaatayaasha iyo mawduuca, si uu uga muuqdo muuqaalka Email; jawaabaha waxay noqdaan faallooyinkiisa. Calaamadaha Gmail waxay noqdaan calaamado. Lifaaqyada lama soo dejiyo.
import-board-instruction-ical: Dooro fayl kalandar .ics ah, sida Google Calendar, Apple Calendar ama Reminders, Thunderbird, Nextcloud ama Outlook u dhoofiyaan, ama dhaji qoraalkiisa. Hawlaha waxay aadaan To Do, In Progress, Done ama Cancelled iyadoo loo eegayo xaaladdooda, dhacdooyinkuna Events, oo leh taariikhaha bilowga iyo kama dambaysta, si ay uga muuqdaan muuqaallada Calendar iyo Gantt. Qaybaha iyo mudnaanta waxay noqdaan calaamado. Walxaha soo noqnoqda hal mar ayaa la soo dejiyaa.
import-board-instruction-googletakeout: Ka dooro takeout.google.com Tasks, Keep, Mail, Calendar iyo Google Chat, samee dhoofinta oo soo dejiso faylka .zip, kadibna halkan ka dooro. Badeecad kastaa waxay noqotaa waddo: boostada muuqaalka Email, liisaska hawlaha iyo qoraallada oo leh liisaskooda hubinta, dhacdooyinka kalandarka iyo hawlaha leh taariikho, iyo meelaha sheekeysiga oo fariimahoodu yihiin faallooyin muuqaalka Chat. Badeecadaha kale iyo lifaaqyada lama soo dejiyo.
import-board-instruction-slack: Slack gudihiisa, fur dejinta goobta shaqada, dooro Import/Export Data, dhoofi goobta shaqada oo soo dejiso faylka .zip, kadibna halkan ka dooro. Kanaal kastaa wuxuu noqdaa kaar ku jira Channels, Groups ama Direct messages, fariimihiisa iyo jawaabaha xariiqyaduna waxay noqdaan faallooyinka kaarka, qoraagooda, si muuqaalka Chat u muujiyo kanaalka. Faylasha lama soo dejiyo.
import-board-instruction-mattermost: Ku dhoofi mmctl export create, soo dejiso dhoofinta oo dooro faylkeeda .jsonl, ama dhaji qoraalkeeda. Kanaal kasta iyo fariin toos ah waxay noqdaan kaar, qoraalladiisa iyo jawaabahiisuna waxay noqdaan faallooyinka kaarka, si muuqaalka Chat u muujiyo kanaalka. Kooxaha waxay noqdaan waddooyin. Faylasha lama soo dejiyo.
import-board-instruction-telegram: Telegram Desktop gudihiisa, fur Settings, Advanced, Export Telegram data, dooro qaabka JSON oo dhoofi, kadibna dooro faylka result.json, ama dhaji qoraalkiisa. Sheekeysi kastaa wuxuu noqdaa kaar ku jira Direct messages, Groups ama Channels, fariimihiisuna waxay noqdaan faallooyinka kaarka, si muuqaalka Chat u muujiyo sheekeysiga. Sawirrada iyo faylasha lama soo dejiyo.
import-board-instruction-whatsapp: WhatsApp gudihiisa, fur sheekeysiga, dooro Export chat la'aanta warbaahinta, oo halkan ka dooro faylka .txt, ama dhaji qoraalkiisa. Sheekeysigu wuxuu noqdaa kaar fariimihiisu yihiin faallooyinkiisa, diraha iyo waqtiga, si muuqaalka Chat u muujiyo. Warbaahinta iyo fariimaha nidaamka lama soo dejiyo.
import-board-instruction-discord: Ku dhoofi kanaal Discord ah DiscordChatExporter qaabka JSON oo dooro faylka .json, ama dhaji qoraalkiisa. Kanaalku wuxuu noqdaa kaar ku jira qaybtiisa, fariimihiisuna waxay noqdaan faallooyinka kaarka, si muuqaalka Chat u muujiyo kanaalka. Server-ku wuxuu noqdaa waddada. Lifaaqyada lama soo dejiyo.
import-board-instruction-rocketchat: Rocket.Chat gudihiisa, ka dhoofi xogtaada sida JSON "My Data" oo dooro faylka .zip ee uu kuu soo diro, ama faylka .json ee la dhoofiyay ee hal qol. Qol kastaa wuxuu noqdaa kaar, fariimihiisuna waxay noqdaan faallooyinka kaarka, si muuqaalka Chat u muujiyo qolka. Faylka .zip ee WeKan u dhoofiyo soo-dejiyaha CSV ee Rocket.Chat sidoo kale waa la akhriyaa.
import-board-instruction-evernote: Evernote gudihiisa, u dhoofi qoraallada ama buug qoraal ah fayl .enex ah oo halkan ka dooro, ama dhaji qoraalkiisa. Qoraal kastaa wuxuu noqdaa kaar leh qoraalkiisa, sanduuqyadiisa hawlaha oo ah liis hubin, summadihiisa oo ah calaamado iyo xasuusiyihiisa oo ah taariikhda ugu dambeysa; qoraallada xasuusiyahoodu dhammaaday waxay aadaan Done. Sawirrada iyo faylasha ku lifaaqan lama soo dejiyo.
tool-group-tasks: Abka hawlaha iyo waxyaabaha la qabanayo
import-board-instruction-trello: Sabuuraddaada Trello, aad 'Menu', dabadeed 'More', 'Print and Export', 'Export JSON', ka dibna koobi qoraalka soo baxa.
import-board-instruction-csv: Ku dheji Qiimayaasha Hakadka Lagu Kala Saaray (CSV)/ Qiimayaasha Tab Lagu Kala Saaray (TSV).
import-board-instruction-jira: Ku dheji JSON-ka raadinta arrimaha Jira Cloud REST API (GET /rest/api/3/search/jql), ama walax u dhiganta { "issues": [...] }. Heerarka Jira waxay noqdaan liisas, arrimuhuna waxay noqdaan kaarar. Ikhtiyaar ahaan ku dar saf "automationRules" si aad xeerar u soo dejiso.
import-board-instruction-excel: Dooro xaashi .xlsx ah oo qaabka WeKan ah (tiirarka la midka ah dhoofinta Excel: Title, Description, Status/List, Members, Labels, dates, custom fields). Safka koowaad waa madaxa.
import-board-instruction-wekan: Sabuuraddaada, aad 'Menu', dabadeed 'Export board', oo koobi qoraalka ku jira faylka la soo dejiyay.
import-board-instruction-about-errors: Haddii aad khaladaad hesho markaad sabuurad soo dejinayso, mararka qaar soo dejintu weli way shaqaysaa, sabuuradduna waxay ku taal bogga Dhammaan Sabuuradaha.
import-without-mapping-members: Soo deji adigoon xubnaha waafajin (mar dambe waafaji)
import-members-mode-map: Mid kasta u dooro isticmaale jira
import-members-mode-placeholder: U hay sidii isticmaaleyaal ku-meel-gaar ah oo magacyadooda leh, si dambe loogu waafajiyo isticmaaleyaal dhab ah
csv-mapping-description: Dooro tiirka faylka ee haya goob kasta oo kaarka ah. Doorashooyinka waxaa laga sameeyay magacyada tiirarka; beddel kuwa khaldan, oo u dooro (kuma jiro faylka) goob uusan faylku lahayn.
csv-mapping-list-missing: Faylku ma laha tiir liiska ah. Mid ka dooro korka, ama qor magaca hal liis oo kaar kasta galayo.
csv-mapping-custom-fields: Tiirar kale oo loo soo dejinayo sidii goobo gaar ah oo qoraal ah:
csv-mapping-boards: Xaashi kasta waxay noqotaa sabuurad u gaar ah:
csv-mapping-list-required: Qor magaca liiska uu kaar kasta galayo, ama dooro tiirka haya liiska.
import-many-boards-hint: Dooro dhowr fayl oo soo saaris ah oo qalabkan ah, ama hal .zip oo haya: fayl kasta wuxuu noqdaa sabuurad u gaar ah, oo la soo dejiyo iyadoo aan xubnaha la waafajin. .zip laftiisu yahay hal soo saaris (Vikunja, Notion, Plane, ama WeKan oo leh lifaaqyo) waa hal sabuurad. Marka faylal halkan laga doorto, Soo dejin ayaa iyaga soo dejisa halkii goobta sare.
import-one-board-per-project-hint: Waddo kasta oo soo dejintu samayn lahayd (mashruuc, gal ama liis oo qalabka ah) waxay noqotaa sabuurad u gaar ah. Kaararka waalidka iyo ku-tiirsanaanta u dhexeeya sabuuradahaas waxaa lagu taxaa warbixinta soo dejinta.
import-many-progress: Waa la soo dejinayaa __done__ ka mid ah __total__: __name__
export-all-boards-hint: Sabuurad kasta oo aad soo saari karto, hal soo dejin: Excel sidii hal buug oo leh xaashi sabuurad kasta oo magaceeda ku magacaaban, qaab kasta oo kalena sidii .zip oo leh fayl sabuurad kasta.
import-json-placeholder: Halkan ku dheji xogtaada JSON ee saxda ah
import-csv-placeholder: Halkan ku dheji xogtaada CSV/TSV ee saxda ah
import-json-file: Ama dooro fayl Trello JSON ah
import-attachments-zip: ZIP lifaaqyada Trello (ikhtiyaari, kana yimid Trello Card Attachments Downloader)
import-trello-json-file-hint: Hal sabuurad Trello oo loo dhoofiyay .json. Haddii aad kaydisay furaha iyo token-ka Trello API, lifaaqyadeeda, gadaasha sabuuradda iyo sawirrada xubnaha sidoo kale waa la soo dejinayaa.
import-trello-zip-file-hint: Fayl .zip ah oo leh hal ama ka badan faylal sabuuradeed .json iyo lifaaqyadooda oo ku jira gal-hoosaadyo magaca-sabuuradda leh (kana yimid Trello Card Attachments Downloader). Dhammaan sabuuradaha waa la soo dejinayaa.
import-trello-zip-no-boards: Wax faylal sabuuradeed Trello .json ah lagama helin .zip-ka.
import-trello-zip-progress: Sabuuradaha ayaa laga soo dejinayaa .zip, fadlan sug…
import-trello-failed: Ka soo dejinta Trello way fashilantay.
import-timeout: Soo dejintu aad bay u dheeraatay waana la joojiyay. Fadlan isku day mar kale; haddii ay sii dhacdo, sabuuraddu aad bay u weynaan kartaa ama kaydka xogtu mashquul ayuu noqon karaa.
import-too-large: Faylku aad buu u weyn yahay in hal mar la soo dejiyo. U kala qaybi faylal yaryar, tusaale ahaan mashruuc ama taariikh ahaan, oo mid walba gooni u soo deji.
import-trello-zip-read-failed: Lama akhriyi karin .zip-ka la soo geliyay.
import-trello-zip-too-large: .zip-ku aad buu u weyn yahay in la soo dejiyo.
import-trello-zip-too-many-files: .zip-ku wuxuu leeyahay faylal aad u badan in la soo dejiyo.
import-trello-zip-file-too-large: Fayl ku jira .zip-ka aad buu u weyn yahay in la soo dejiyo.
import-trello-zip-unsafe-path: .zip-ku wuxuu leeyahay waddooyin fayl oo aan ammaan ahayn waana la diiday.
import-trello-workspace: Magaca goobta shaqada ee gaarka ah (ikhtiyaari)
import-attachment-auth-hint: Dhoofintu waxay magacaabaysaa lifaaqyadeeda laakiin ma sido faylasha. Si aad u keento, sii cinwaanka adeegga iyo gelitaan: waxaa loo isticmaalaa soo dejintan oo keliya, waxaa loo diraa cinwaankaas oo keliya, mana la kaydiyo weligood. Ka tag madhan si aad u soo dejiso faylasha la'aantood.
import-attachment-auth-token: Calaamadda API, furaha API ama furaha sirta ee app-ka
import-trello-workspace-placeholder: Sabuuradda la soo dejiyay waxaa la hoos dhigaa goobtan shaqada, waana la sameeyaa haddii aysan jirin
import-trello-parent-workspace: Goobaha shaqada la soo dejiyay hoos dhig
trello-api-import: Si toos ah uga soo deji Trello adigoo adeegsanaya furaha API iyo token
trello-api-import-desc: Ku dheji furahaaga iyo token-ka Trello API si aad u taxdo goobaha shaqada iyo sabuuradaha Trello, dabadeedna kuwa la doortay ula soo deji lifaaqyadooda.
trello-api-token: Token-ka Trello API (gacanta laga sameeyo hoosta furaha API)
trello-api-credentials-required: Fadlan geli furaha iyo token-ka Trello API labadaba.
trello-api-credentials-saved: Furaha iyo token-ka Trello API waa la kaydiyay. Waxaad taxdaa goobaha shaqada adigoon mar kale gelin.
trello-export-desc: Ku samee nuqul sabuuraddan ah Trello adigoo adeegsanaya API-ga Trello, furahaaga API-ga Trello iyo token-kaaga. Waddooyinku waxay noqdaan calaamado la yiraahdo "Swimlane: …", oo soo dejinta Trello ee WeKan ay dib ugu celiso waddooyin.
trello-export-warnings: Wax walba lama soo saari karin
sandstorm-trello-access-needed: Grain Sandstorm ah ma laha gelitaan Internet oo u gaar ah. Marka hore u oggolow grain-kan inuu gaaro Trello.
sandstorm-trello-save-label: Trello, si loo soo dejiyo loona soo saaro sabuuradaha
trello-select-boards: Fadlan dooro ugu yaraan hal sabuurad oo la soo dejiyo.
trello-cancel-delete: Jooji oo tirtir kuwa la soo dejiyay

r-wrike-workflow-note: Habka shaqada Wrike waa liis xaalado ah, mid kastaa wuxuu ku jiraa kooxda Active, Completed, Deferred ama Cancelled. Soo saaristu waxay u qortaa liisaska sabuuraddan sidii hal hab oo magaca sabuuradda leh, qaabka JSON ee API-ga Wrike u celiyo habababka shaqada: ku samee habkaas Wrike ka hor intaadan soo dejin soo saarista Excel ee Wrike ee sabuuradda, si xaaladihiisa loo dabaqo. Soo dejintu waxay akhrisaa JSON-kaas korka lagu dhajiyay, ha ahaado WeKan ama GET /workflows ee Wrike, una gelisaa sabuuradda la doortay: xaalad aan liis lahayn waxay noqotaa liis, xeerna wuxuu kaar u calaamadeeyaa la dhammeeyay marka loo raro xaalad Completed ama Cancelled, aan la dhammeyn marka uu ku jiro mid Active ama Deferred. Xeerarka otomaatiga ah ee Wrike laftiisa lagama soo saari karo Wrike.

globalSearch-instructions-description: Raadintu waxay yeelan kartaa hawlwadeenno lagu sii qeexo raadinta. Hawlwadeennada waxaa lagu tilmaamaa iyadoo magaca hawlwadeenka iyo qiimaha lagu kala saarayo laba-dhibcood. Tusaale ahaan, qeexidda hawlwadeenka `list:Blocked` waxay raadinta ku koobaysaa kaararka ku jira liis la yiraahdo *Blocked*. Haddii qiimuhu leeyahay meelo bannaan ama xarfo gaar ah, waa in lagu dhex xiraa calaamadaha xigashada (tusaale `__operator_list__:"To Review"`).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-board: `__operator_board__:<title>` - kaararka ku jira sabuuradaha la waafaqa *<title>* la cayimay
globalSearch-instructions-operator-list: `__operator_list__:<title>` - kaararka ku jira liisaska la waafaqa *<title>* la cayimay
globalSearch-instructions-operator-swiml: `__operator_swimlane__:<title>` - kaararka ku jira waddooyinka la waafaqa *<title>* la cayimay
globalSearch-instructions-operator-comme: `__operator_comment__:<text>` - kaararka leh faallo ay ku jirto *<text>*.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-label: `__operator_label__:<color>` `__operator_label__:<name>` - kaararka leh sumad la waafaqa *<color>* ama *<name>
globalSearch-instructions-operator-org: `__operator_org__:<display name|short name>` - kaararka leh sabuurad loo qoondeeyey ururka *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-team: `__operator_team__:<display name|short name>` - kaararka leh sabuurad loo qoondeeyey kooxda *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - kaararka waqtigoodu ku egyahay ilaa *<n>* maalmood laga bilaabo hadda. `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ wuxuu taxayaa dhammaan kaararka taariikhdooda kama dambaysta ahi dhaaftay.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - kaararka la abuuray *<n>* maalmood ka hor ama ka yar
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - kaararka la beddelay *<n>* maalmood ka hor ama ka yar
globalSearch-instructions-operator-statu: `__operator_status__:<status>` - halka *<status>* uu yahay mid ka mid ah kuwan:
globalSearch-instructions-status-all: `__predicate_all__` - dhammaan kaararka la kaydiyey iyo kuwa aan la kaydin
globalSearch-instructions-status-public: `__predicate_public__` - kaararka ku jira sabuuradaha dadweynaha oo keliya
globalSearch-instructions-status-private: `__predicate_private__` - kaararka ku jira sabuuradaha gaarka ah oo keliya
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - halka *<field>* uu yahay mid ka mid ah `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` ama `__predicate_member__`. Ku dhejinta `-` horta *<field>* waxay raadisaa maqnaanshaha qiime goobtaas ku jira (tusaale `has:-due` wuxuu raadiyaa kaararka aan lahayn taariikh kama dambays ah).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - halka *<sort-name>* uu yahay mid ka mid ah `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` ama `__predicate_modified__`. Kala-soocid hoos u socota, ku dheji `-` horta magaca kala-soocidda.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - halka *<n>* uu yahay tiro togan oo dhan oo sheegaysa tirada kaararka lagu muujinayo bog kasta.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-1: Hawlwadeenno badan ayaa la cayimi karaa.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Hawlwadeennada isku midka ah waxaa la isugu daraa *OR*. Kaararka waafaqa mid kasta oo xaaladaha ka mid ah ayaa la soo celinayaa.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` wuxuu soo celinayaa kaararka ku jira liis kasta oo la yiraahdo *Blocked* ama *Available*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Hawlwadeennada kala duwan waxaa la isugu daraa *AND*. Keliya kaararka waafaqa dhammaan hawlwadeennada kala duwan ayaa la soo celinayaa. `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` wuxuu soo celiyaa keliya kaararka ku jira liiska *Available* ee leh sumad *red*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Maalmaha waxaa lagu cayimi karaa tiro dhan oo togan ama taban, ama iyadoo la adeegsanayo `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` ama `__predicate_year__` muddada hadda jirta.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-4: Raadinta qoraalku ma kala soocdo far waaweyn iyo far yaryar.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-5: Asal ahaan kaararka la kaydiyey lama raadiyo.

database-migration-description: U guuri xogta qoraalka ku salaysan (wax kasta marka laga reebo lifaaqyada iyo sawirrada astaanta, kuwaas oo ku sii jira nidaamka faylasha) MongoDB iyo FerretDB v1 (SQLite) dhexdooda. Kaydka xogta kale waa inuu socdaa lana gaari karaa (dekedaha asalka ah: FerretDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018, MongoDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27019; ku beddel WEKAN_FERRETDB_URL / WEKAN_MONGODB_URL). Marka uu dhammaado, MONGO_URL u tilmaam kaydka xogta kale oo dib u bilow WeKan (Snap-ka: snap set wekan database=ferretdb ama =mongodb).
database-migrate-to-ferretdb: Xogta qoraalka u guuri FerretDB v1 (SQLite)
database-migration-confirm: Dhammaan ururinta qoraalka ku salaysan ma loo koobiyeyaa __db__? Lifaaqyada iyo sawirrada astaanta ee nidaamka faylasha waxba ma gaarayaan. Kaydka xogta bartilmaameedku waa inuu socdaa.
sandstorm-migration-description: Marka WeKan ku dhex socdo grain Sandstorm ah, kaydkiisii hore ee MongoDB 3 waxaa loo guuriyaa FerretDB v1 (SQLite) marka ugu horreysa ee la bilaabo, lifaaqyada iyo sawirrada astaantana kaydka xogta waxaa looga raraa galalka grain-ka ee files/attachments iyo files/avatars. Tani waxay muujinaysaa in guuritaanku guulaystay iyo inta boos saxan ee faylasha ceeriin ee kaydkii hore ee MongoDB weli ku isticmaalaan grain-ka, waxayna kuu oggolaanaysaa inaad tirtirto faylashaas ceeriin si aad boos u bannayso.

sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-description: Guuritaan guulaystay ka dib xogtu waxay ku jirtaa FerretDB iyo nidaamka faylasha, sidaas darteed faylasha ceeriin ee kaydkii hore ee MongoDB 3 waa la tirtiri karaa si booska saxanka grain-ka loo bannayn karo. Dib looma celin karo.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-confirm: Ma la tirtiraa faylasha ceeriin ee kaydka xogta MongoDB 3 si booska saxanka loo bannaysto? Xogta hore ayaa loogu guuriyey FerretDB iyo nidaamka faylasha. Dib looma celin karo.

card-field-visibility-desc: Meelaha ku jira Dejinta sabuuradda / Kaarka ee sabuuraduhu muujin karaan. Meel aan la calaamadin ayaa laga qariyaa dhammaan kaararka, kaararka yaryar iyo Dejinta sabuuradda / Kaarka ee sabuurad kasta. Xogta kaararka iyo dejinta sabuuraduhu ma beddelmaan. Marka dib loo calaamadiyo, sabuurad kasta waxay u muuqataa sidii hore loogu dejiyey. Sabuurad kasta waxay leedahay kala-habaynteeda meelaha.
cards-loading-description: WeKan si otomaatig ah ayuu u soo raraa kaararka sabuuradda: sabuurad weyn (ka sarreysa xadka cabbirka) waxay soo rartaa keliya kaararka hadda muuqda (rogid aan dhammaad lahayn) iyo tiro toos ah, si ay u degdegto una adeegsato xusuus iyo xawaare-xiriir yar, halka sabuuradaha yaryar ay soo raraan kaar kasta si loo helo waayo-aragnimada ugu fudud ee dhammaan awoodaha leh. Wax la qaabeeyo ma jiraan. Hawlwadeennadu weli waxay qasbi karaan hab iyagoo adeegsanaya doorsoomayaasha deegaanka CARDS_LOADING (all/lazy/auto) iyo CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Soo rarista caajiska ah ee kaararku waa tijaabo: tiriyeyaasha kaararka iyo xuduudaha WIP waa sax, laakiin muuqaalada Calendar/Table/Gantt iyo xulashada badan waxay ka tarjumayaan keliya kaararka ilaa hadda la soo raray. Dib u rar sabuuradaha furan ka dib markaad tan beddesho.
render-links-as-plain-text: Xiriirrada u muuji qoraal caadi ah
render-links-as-plain-text-description: Marka ay shidan tahay, dhammaan xiriirrada (xiriirrada markdown sida [label](url) iyo summadaha HTML ceeriin ee <a href>) mar walba waxaa loogu muujiyaa qoraal caadi ah oo aan la gujin karin goob kasta oo qoraal hodan ah (cinwaannada sabuuradda iyo kaarka, sharraxaadaha, faallooyinka, liisaska hubinta, iwm.). Tani waxay ka hortagtaa xiriirro la gujin karo oo marin-habaabin ah. Asal ahaan way dansan tahay, sidaas darteed xiriirradu waa la gujin karaa.
always-show-code-as-text: Mar walba koodhka oo dhan u muuji qoraal caadi ah
always-show-code-as-text-description: Marka ay shidan tahay, qoraalka hodanka ah marna looma soo bandhigo markdown ama HTML: isha oo dhan mar walba waxaa loogu muujiyaa qoraal caadi ah goob kasta oo qoraal hodan ah (cinwaannada sabuuradda iyo kaarka, sharraxaadaha, faallooyinka, liisaska hubinta, iwm.). Tani waxay muujisaa nuxurka qarsoon—faallooyinka HTML (<!-- -->), bartilmaameedka xiriirrada markdown, JavaScript iyo koodh kasta oo kale—si koodhka oo dhan mar walba u muuqdo, aan loo gujin karin, una socon. Asal ahaan way dansan tahay, sidaas darteed markdown si caadi ah ayaa loo soo bandhigaa.
disable-all-import-description: Marka ay shidan tahay, dhammaan awoodaha soo dejintu way dansan yihiin: ka soo dejinta sabuurad WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea iyo Forgejo, iyo sidoo kale koobiyeynta sabuurad. Xulashooyinka liiska soo dejinta waa qarsoon yihiin, adeeguhuna wuu diidayaa codsi kasta oo soo dejin ah. Asal ahaan way dansan tahay.
import-max-megabytes-description: Faylka ugu weyn ee bogga soo dejintu aqbalo, megabytes ahaan. Madhan waxay ka dhigan tahay xad la'aan: fayl wuxuu noqon karaa inta weyn ee meesha bannaan ee diskigu u oggolaato in soo dejintu dhammaato. Soo gelin kasta waxaa lagu qoraa diskiga server-ka qayb qayb, soo dejin buuxin lahayd diskigana waa la diidaa.
import-disk-full: Meel bannaan oo ku filan kuma jirto diskiga server-ka soo dejintan.
import-upload-not-found: Faylka la soo geliyay hadda ma jiro. Mar kale dooro.
import-upload-aborted: Soo gelinta waa la kala jaray.
disable-all-export-description: Marka ay shidan tahay, dhammaan awoodaha dhoofintu way dansan yihiin: u dhoofinta sabuurad WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, ama NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, iyo dhoofinta hal lifaaq. Xulashooyinka liiska dhoofinta waa qarsoon yihiin, adeeguhuna wuu diidayaa codsi kasta oo dhoofin ah. Asal ahaan way dansan tahay.
disable-import-avatars-description: Marka ay shidan tahay, sawirrada astaanta (sawirrada bogga isticmaalaha) marna lama soo dejiyo. Tani waxay khusaysaa soo dejinta WeKan JSON, soo dejinta Trello iyo waafajinta sawirka astaanta ee bixiyeyaasha aqoonsiga dibadda marka la gelayo (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Magacyada iyo xogta kale weli waa la soo dejiyaa; sawirrada astaanta oo keliya ayaa la dhaafaa. Asal ahaan way dansan tahay.
disable-export-avatars-description: Marka ay shidan tahay, sawirrada astaanta (sawirrada bogga isticmaalaha) marna laguma daro marka sabuurad la dhoofinayo (dhoofinta WeKan JSON iyo CSV). Magacyada isticmaalaha iyo xogta kale weli waa la dhoofiyaa; sawirrada astaanta oo keliya ayaa laga reebaa. Asal ahaan way dansan tahay.
anonymize-import-users: Qari aqoonsiga isticmaalayaasha la soo dejiyo
anonymize-import-users-description: Marka ay shidan tahay, soo dejinta sabuurad WeKan JSON waxay magaca isticmaalaha, magaca buuxa iyo xarfaha hore ee isticmaale kasta oo la soo dejiyey ku beddeshaa meeleeyayaal tiro leh (user1, user2, ...), waxay tuurtaa sawirkooda astaanta, waxayna dib u qortaa xusitaanka @username (iyo goobaha requested-by / assigned-by) ee nuxurka kaarka iyo faallada la soo dejiyey. Wax aqoonsi isticmaale oo dhab ah oo sabuuradda isha ka yimid lama kaydiyo. Erayga "isticmaale" wuxuu raacaa luqadda qofka wax soo dejinaya. Asal ahaan way dansan tahay.
anonymize-export-users-description: Marka ay shidan tahay, dhoofinta sabuuraddu waxay magaca isticmaalaha, magaca buuxa iyo xarfaha hore ee isticmaale kasta oo la dhoofiyey ku beddeshaa meeleeyayaal tiro leh (user1, user2, ...), waxay tuurtaa sawirkooda astaanta, waxayna dib u qortaa xusitaanka @username (iyo goobaha requested-by / assigned-by) ee nuxurka kaarka iyo faallada. Faylka la dhoofiyey ma sido wax aqoonsi isticmaale oo dhab ah. Erayga "isticmaale" wuxuu raacaa luqadda qofka wax dhoofinaya. Asal ahaan way dansan tahay.
anonymize-account: Qari aqoonsiga isticmaalayaasha la soo dejiyo
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: Marka ay shidan tahay, dhoofinta sabuuraddu waxay magaca isticmaalaha, magaca buuxa iyo xarfaha hore ee isticmaale kasta oo la dhoofiyey ku beddeshaa meeleeyayaal tiro leh (user1, user2, ...), waxay tuurtaa sawirkooda astaanta, waxayna dib u qortaa xusitaanka @username (iyo goobaha requested-by / assigned-by) ee nuxurka kaarka iyo faallada. Faylka la dhoofiyey ma sido wax aqoonsi isticmaale oo dhab ah. Erayga "isticmaale" wuxuu raacaa luqadda qofka wax dhoofinaya. Asal ahaan way dansan tahay.
disable-activities-description: Marka ay shidan tahay, gelinnada quudinta hawsha marna lama diiwaangeliyo meelna laguma muujiyo (dhinaca sabuuradda iyo tabka hawsha kaarka). Wax taariikh ah oo cidda waxa samaysay lama hayo. Asal ahaan way dansan tahay.
disable-notifications-description: Marka ay shidan tahay, WeKan marna ma diro ogeysiisyada la-socodka (gudaha abka, iimayl ama adeegyo kale) hawl kasta. Hawlaha weli waa la diiwaangelin karaa (haddii aan sidoo kale kor laga damin); ogeysiisyada oo keliya ayaa la joojiyaa. Asal ahaan way dansan tahay.
disable-watch-description: Marka ay shidan tahay, awoodda la-socodku way dansan tahay—isticmaalayaashu iskuma qori karaan sabuuradaha, liisaska ama kaararka si ay ogeysiisyo u helaan, isku-day kasta oo lagu beddelayo heerka la-socodkana waa la diidayaa. Asal ahaan way dansan tahay.
backup-description: Samee nuqul-kayd Lifaaqyada, Sawirrada Astaanta iyo/ama Xogta (dhammaan ururinta qoraalka ku salaysan ee aan ahayn lifaaqyo ama sawirro astaan). Faylka .zip si toos ah ayaa loogu qulquliyaa kaydka la doortay—fayl ku-meelgaar ah ma jiro—sida backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, isagoo ka kooban YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars iyo /data. Kaydadka daruurta (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) waxay adeegsadaan aqoonsiyada lagu qaabeeyey tabyadooda kaydka.
backup-scope-description: Nidaamka oo dhan, ama hal Urur. Nuqul-kaydka Ururku wuxuu ka kooban yahay sabuuradihiisa iyo wax kasta oo saaran, oo ay ku jiraan lifaaqyada sabuuradahaas—laakiin kuma jiraan akoonnada isticmaalaha iyo dejimaha nidaamka, sababtoo ah kuwaas waxaa wadaaga Urur kasta. Soo-celinta nuqul-kaydka Ururku waxay wax ku qortaa keliya sabuuradaha Ururkaasi leeyahay.
continuous-backup-description: Isbeddel kasta oo ku dhaca kaydka xogta, lifaaqyada, sawirrada astaanta iyo diiwaannada ayuu ilbiriqsiyo gudahood ugu gudbiyaa gal, si xogta loogu soo celin karo xaaladdii ay ku jirtay waqti kasta. Wuxuu la shaqeeyaa nuqul-kaydka jadwalaysan ee sameeya kaydyo dhammaystiran.
continuous-backup-enabled: Ku socodsii nuqul-kayd joogto ah adeegahan
continuous-backup-target: Galka bartilmaameedka (waddo buuxda oo ku taal saxan kale, meel shabakadda laga wadaago ama meel rclone lagu xiray)
wekan-data-no-database: Lama helin kaydka xogta WeKan oo la akhrin karo.
continuous-backup-engine-sqlite: Bogagga SQLite (bogagga isbeddelay muddadii u dhexeysay hubinnada)
continuous-backup-engine-litestream: Litestream (barnaamij ikhtiyaari ah oo aad rakibato)
continuous-backup-engine-none: Ma jiro matoor kaydka xogta ah oo ku shaqayn kara adeegahan
continuous-backup-key-file: Faylka furaha sirgelinta (waddo buuxda oo ka baxsan galka bartilmaameedka; 64 xaraf oo heksadesimal ah ama weedh sir ah oo ugu yaraan 16 xaraf leh). Hayso nuqul: la'aantiis nuqul-kaydka dib looma soo celin karo.
continuous-backup-fetched: Faylasha waxaa laga soo qaaday daruurta
continuous-backup-litestream-binary: Faylka la fulin karo ee Litestream (waddo buuxda)
continuous-backup-restore-points: Meelaha dib loogu soo celin karo
continuous-backup-restore-sqlite: Faylka kaydka xogta SQLite (waxaa laga sameeyaa agta nuqul-kaydka, marnaba laguma dul qoro faylka hadda la isticmaalayo)
continuous-backup-apply-on-restart: Marka xigta ee dib loo bilaabo, adeegso keydka xogta SQLite ee dib loo dhisay (keydka xogta ee la beddelayo waa la haynayaa)
continuous-backup-restore-confirm: Ma lagu soo celiyaa jiilka la doortay xaaladdii waqtiga la doortay? Nuqul-kaydka joogtada ah si ku-meelgaar ah ayuu u hakadaa inta dib u soo celintu socoto.
continuous-backup-restore-done: Dib u soo celintii way dhammaatay
continuous-backup-saved: Dejimaha nuqul-kaydka joogtada ah waa la kaydiyay
backup-restore-select-first: Marka hore liiska ka dooro nuqul-kayd.
backup-restore-confirm: Ma la soo celiyaa nuqul-kaydka la doortay? Lifaaqyada/sawirrada astaanta waxaa lagu qoraa nidaamka faylasha, xogtana kaydka xogta iyadoo la raacayo habka la doortay.
gcs-key-filename-description: Ikhtiyaari: jidka faylka furaha JSON ee akoonka adeegga ee adeegaha.
gcs-credentials-description: Ikhtiyaari: ku dheji furaha JSON ee akoonka adeegga. Bannaan uga tag si aad u adeegsato faylka furaha ama aqoonsiyada asalka ah.
gcs-permissions-note: Sii akoonka adeegga WeKan awood akhris/qoris oo baaldiga ah: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → baaldigaaga → Permissions → Grant access. Gudaha "New principals", ku dheji iimaylka akoonka adeegga—qiimaha "client_email" ee furahaaga JSON—kadib dooro doorka "Storage Object Admin" oo Kaydi.
cloud-secret-keep-blank: Bannaan uga tag si aad qiimaha hadda u hayso.
azure-container-description: Weelka blob ee faylasha lagu kaydinayo.
gcs-bucket-description: Magaca baaldiga Cloud Storage ee faylasha lagu kaydinayo.
s3-endpoint-menu-path: AWS: bannaan uga tag (wuxuu adeegsadaa barta dhammaadka gobolka). Kuwa S3 la jaanqaada: Endpoint URL-ka ka socda qalabkaaga MinIO / Cloudflare R2 / Backblaze B2 / Wasabi / DigitalOcean Spaces.
s3-region-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → baaldigaaga → Properties → AWS Region.
s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → magaca baaldigaaga (ama Create bucket → Bucket name).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → Users → isticmaalahaaga → Security credentials → Access keys → Create access key → dooro xaaladda adeegsiga 'Application running outside AWS' → Create access key. Waxaa loo muujiyaa 'Access key ID'.
s3-secret-key-menu-path: Isla shaashadda Access key ID; 'Secret access key' waxaa la muujiyaa hal mar oo keliya marka furaha la abuuro—markaas koobiyee (ama Download .csv).
azure-account-name-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akoonkaaga → magaca kore lagu muujiyey (sidoo kale hoosta Security + networking → Access keys → Storage account name).
azure-account-key-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akoonkaaga → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Show → Key.
azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akoonkaaga → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Connection string → Show.
azure-container-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akoonkaaga → Data storage → Containers → weelkaaga (ama + Container si aad mid u abuurto).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → xulaha mashruuca ee kore → ID-ga mashruucaaga (Cloud overview → Dashboard → Project info → Project ID).
gcs-bucket-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → magaca baaldigaaga (ama Create si aad mid u samayso).
gcs-key-filename-menu-path: Jidka adeegaha WeKan ee faylka furaha JSON ee akoonka adeegga la soo dejiyey (hoos laga abuuray). Adeegso kan AMA JSON-ka ku dheji goobta hoose.
gcs-credentials-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → IAM & Admin → Service accounts → akoonkaaga adeegga → Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON → Create (wuxuu soo dejiyaa faylka). Nuxurkiisa halkan ku dheji, ama kaydi faylka oo jidkiisa kor ku deji.
cloud-secret-set: (waa la kaydiyey—bannaan uga tag si aad u hayso)
cloud-settings-desc: WeKan oo ku jira Weddy, Cloud Panel wuxuu hal server uga adeegaa domains badan oo WeKan ah, mid kastaana xogtiisa gaarka ah ayuu leeyahay. Domainka Cloud Panel, SuperAdmin ayaa maamula domains-ka iyo CloudFlare.
cloud-panel-not-allowed: Cloud Panel waxaa loogu talagalay SuperAdmin oo keliya, domainka Cloud Panel.
cloudflare-api-key-desc: Marka uu jiro furaha CloudFlare API, domain-ka aagiisu ku jiro koontadaada CloudFlare wuxuu helaa diiwaan DNS ah oo proxy ah iyo shahaadada CloudFlare Origin. Domains-ka kale waxay helaan shahaado Let's Encrypt. Furaha waxaa lagu kaydiyaa server-ka mar dambena lama muujiyo.
cloudflare-api-key-set: Furaha CloudFlare API waa la kaydiyay.
cloudflare-api-key-not-set: Ma jiro furaha CloudFlare API oo la kaydiyay: domain kastaa wuxuu helaa shahaado Let's Encrypt.
attachment-move-storage-azure: Lifaaqa u dhaqaaji Azure Blob Storage
attachment-move-storage-gcs: Lifaaqa u dhaqaaji Google Cloud Storage
gridfs-enabled-description: U adeegso MongoDB GridFS kaydinta faylasha
migration-paused: Guuritaannada si guul leh ayaa loo hakiyey
migration-started: Guuritaannada si guul leh ayaa loo bilaabay
migration-stop-confirm: Ma hubtaa inaad joojinayso dhammaan guuritaannada?
migration-stopped: Guuritaannada si guul leh ayaa loo joojiyey
gridfs-move-collectionfs-note: Si lifaaqyada iyo sawirrada astaantu u muuqdaan, ka rar CollectionFS una rar Kayd kasta oo kale.
s3-access-key-description: Furaha gelitaanka AWS S3 ee xaqiijinta
s3-bucket-description: Magaca baaldiga S3 ee lagu kaydiyo faylasha
s3-enabled-description: U adeegso AWS S3 ama MinIO kaydinta faylasha
s3-endpoint-description: URL-ka barta dhammaadka S3 (tusaale, s3.amazonaws.com ama minio.example.com)
s3-secret-key-description: Furaha sirta AWS S3 ee xaqiijinta
s3-secret-key-required: Furaha sirta S3 waa loo baahan yahay
s3-settings-saved: Dejimaha S3 si guul leh ayaa loo kaydiyey
writable-path-description: Jidka galka saldhigga u ah kaydinta faylasha
comprehensive-board-migration-descriptio: Wuxuu sameeyaa hubinno iyo hagaajinno dhamaystiran oo daacadnimada xogta sabuuradda ah, oo ay ku jiraan kala-horraynta liisaska, boosaska kaararka iyo qaab-dhismeedka waddooyinka.
delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migration: Tirtir Liisaska Madhan ee Nuqulka ah
delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migration-d: Si ammaan ah ayuu u tirtiraa liisaska madhan ee nuqulka ah. Wuxuu saaraa keliya liisaska aan lahayn kaarar OO leh liis kale oo isla cinwaankaas ah oo kaarar ku jiraan.
restore-lost-cards-migration-description: Wuxuu helaa oo soo celiyaa kaararka iyo liisaska ay ka maqan yihiin swimlaneId ama listId. Wuxuu abuuraa waddo 'Kaararka Lumay' ah si dhammaan walxaha lumay mar kale u muuqdaan.
restore-all-archived-migration: Soo Celi Dhammaan Kuwa La Kaydiyey
restore-all-archived-migration-descripti: Wuxuu soo celiyaa dhammaan waddooyinka, liisaska iyo kaararka la kaydiyey. Si otomaatig ah ayuu u hagaajiyaa swimlaneId ama listId kasta oo maqan si walxuhu u muuqdaan.
fix-missing-lists-migration-description: Wuxuu ogaadaa oo hagaajiyaa liisaska maqan ama dhaawacmay ee qaab-dhismeedka sabuuradda.
fix-avatar-urls-migration-description: Wuxuu cusboonaysiiyaa URL-yada sawirrada astaanta ee xubnaha sabuuradda si ay u adeegsadaan kaydka dambe ee saxda ah, wuxuuna hagaajiyaa tixraacyada sawirrada astaanta ee jaban.
fix-all-file-urls-migration-description: Wuxuu cusboonaysiiyaa dhammaan URL-yada lifaaqyada faylasha ee sabuuraddan si ay u adeegsadaan kaydka dambe ee saxda ah, wuxuuna hagaajiyaa tixraacyada faylasha ee jaban.
migration-successful: Guuritaanku si guul leh ayuu u dhammaaday
migrations-admin-only: Keliya maamulayaasha sabuuradda ayaa socodsiin kara guuritaannada
migrations-description: Socodsii hubinta iyo hagaajinta daacadnimada xogta sabuuraddan. Guuritaan kasta si gaar ah ayaa loo fulin karaa.
run-comprehensive-migration-confirm: Tani waxay samayn doontaa guuritaan dhamaystiran si loo hubiyo loona hagaajiyo daacadnimada xogta sabuuradda. Waxay qaadan kartaa dhowr daqiiqadood. Ma sii waddaa?
run-delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migrati: Tani waxay marka hore liisaska la wadaago u beddeli doontaa liisas waddo kasta gaar u ah, kadibna waxay tirtiri doontaa liisaska madhan ee leh liis nuqul ah oo isla cinwaan leh kaararna ku jiraan. Keliya liisaska madhan ee dhab ahaan dheeraadka ah ayaa la saari doonaa. Ma sii waddaa?
run-restore-lost-cards-migration-confirm: Tani waxay abuuri doontaa waddo 'Kaararka Lumay' ah, waxayna soo celin doontaa dhammaan kaararka iyo liisaska ay ka maqan yihiin swimlaneId ama listId. Tani waxay saamaynaysaa keliya walxaha aan la kaydin. Ma sii waddaa?
run-restore-all-archived-migration-confi: Tani waxay soo celin doontaa DHAMMAAN waddooyinka, liisaska iyo kaararka la kaydiyey, iyadoo mar kale ka dhigaysa kuwo muuqda. Walax kasta oo aqoonsigeedu maqan yahay si otomaatig ah ayaa loo hagaajin doonaa. Tan si fudud dib looguma celin karo. Ma sii waddaa?
run-fix-missing-lists-migration-confirm: Tani waxay ogaan doontaa oo hagaajin doontaa liisaska maqan ama dhaawacmay ee qaab-dhismeedka sabuuradda. Ma sii waddaa?
run-fix-avatar-urls-migration-confirm: Tani waxay cusboonaysiin doontaa URL-yada sawirrada astaanta ee xubnaha sabuuradda si ay u adeegsadaan kaydka dambe ee saxda ah. Ma sii waddaa?
run-fix-all-file-urls-migration-confirm: Tani waxay cusboonaysiin doontaa dhammaan URL-yada lifaaqyada faylasha ee sabuuraddan si ay u adeegsadaan kaydka dambe ee saxda ah. Ma sii waddaa?
restore-lost-cards-nothing-to-restore: Ma jiraan waddooyin, liisas ama kaarar lumay oo la soo celiyo
migration-progress-note: Fadlan sug inta aan sabuuraddaada u guurinayno qaab-dhismeedka ugu dambeeya...
step-delete-duplicate-empty-lists: Tirtir Liisaska Madhan ee Nuqulka ah
step-scan-users: Hubinta sawirrada astaanta ee xubnaha sabuuradda
conversion-info-text: Beddeliddan hal mar ayaa sabuurad kasta lagu sameeyaa, waxayna hagaajisaa waxqabadka. Waxaad si caadi ah u sii adeegsan kartaa sabuuradda.
converting-board-description: Qaab-dhismeedka sabuuradda ayaa loo beddelayaa awood shaqo oo hagaagsan. Tani waxay qaadan kartaa dhowr daqiiqadood.
migration-batch-size-description: Tirada lifaaqyada laga shaqaynayo dufcad kasta (1-100)
migration-cpu-threshold-description: Hakad geli guuritaanka marka adeegsiga CPU uu ka bato boqolleydan (10-90)
migration-delay-ms-description: Dib-u-dhaca u dhexeeya dufcadaha oo millisekan ah (100-10000)
migration-info-text: Guuritaannada kaydka xogta hal mar ayaa la sameeyaa, waxayna hagaajiyaan waxqabadka nidaamka. Hawshu waxay ka sii socotaa gadaasha xataa haddii aad xirto biraawsarkaaga.
migration-warning-text: Fadlan ha xirin biraawsarkaaga inta guuritaanku socdo. Hawshu gadaasha ayay ka sii socon doontaa, laakiin waxay qaadan kartaa waqti dheer inay dhammaato.
showChecklistAtMinicard: Ku Muuji Liiska Hubinta Kaarka Yar

blockly-TEXT_INDEXOF_OPERATOR_LAST: hel halka qoraalku ugu dambayn ka muuqdo
blockly-TEXT_INDEXOF_TOOLTIP: Soo celi tusmada meesha qoraalka koowaad uu ugu horrayn/ugu dambayn kaga muuqdo qoraalka labaad. Soo celi %1 haddii qoraalka la waayo.
blockly-TEXT_ISEMPTY_TOOLTIP: Soo celi run haddii qoraalka la bixiyey madhan yahay.
blockly-TEXT_JOIN_TOOLTIP: Samee qoraal adigoo isku daraya tiro kasta oo shayo ah.
blockly-TEXT_LENGTH_TOOLTIP: Soo celi tirada xarfaha (oo ay ku jiraan meelaha bannaan) ee qoraalka la bixiyey.
blockly-TEXT_PRINT_TOOLTIP: Daabac qoraalka, tirada ama qiimaha kale ee la cayimay.
blockly-TEXT_REPLACE_TOOLTIP: Beddel dhammaan meelaha qoraal uu kaga muuqdo qoraal kale.
blockly-TEXT_TEXT_TOOLTIP: Xaraf, eray ama sadar qoraal ah.
blockly-TEXT_TRIM_OPERATOR_BOTH: ka jar meelaha bannaan labada dhinac ee
blockly-TEXT_TRIM_OPERATOR_LEFT: ka jar meelaha bannaan dhinaca bidix ee
blockly-TEXT_TRIM_OPERATOR_RIGHT: ka jar meelaha bannaan dhinaca midig ee
blockly-TEXT_TRIM_TOOLTIP: Soo celi nuqul qoraalka ah oo meelaha bannaan laga saaray hal daraf ama labada daraf.
blockly-VARIABLES_SET_TOOLTIP: Doorsoomahan u dhig inuu la mid noqdo gelinta.
blockly-VARIABLE_ALREADY_EXISTS: Doorsoome la yiraahdo '%1' ayaa hore u jira.
blockly-VARIABLE_ALREADY_EXISTS_FOR_ANOT: Doorsoome la yiraahdo '%1' ayaa hore ugu jira nooc kale: '%2'.
blockly-VARIABLE_ALREADY_EXISTS_FOR_A_PA: Doorsoome la yiraahdo '%1' ayaa hore u ah cabbir gelin oo ku jira hawsha '%2'.
blockly-WORKSPACE_CONTENTS_BLOCKS_MANY: %1 kooxood oo baloogyo ah%2 ayaa ku jira goobta shaqada.
blockly-WORKSPACE_CONTENTS_BLOCKS_ONE: Hal koox oo baloogyo ah%2 ayaa ku jirta goobta shaqada.
blockly-WORKSPACE_CONTENTS_BLOCKS_ZERO: Wax baloogyo ah ma jiraan%2 gudaha goobta shaqada.
blockly-WORKSPACE_SEARCH_INPUT_LABEL: Ka raadi goobta shaqada. Riix Enter si aad u hesho natiijada xigta, Shift+Enter si aad u hesho natiijadii hore. Riix Escape si aad u xirto raadinta oo aad diiradda u saarto natiijada hadda.
blockly-WORKSPACE_SEARCH_NO_MATCHES: Ma jiraan baloogyo ku habboon raadinta
blockly-ZOOM_TO_FIT_ARIA_LABEL: Weynee ama yaree si ay ugu wada muuqdaan
r-blocks-help: Ku xir hal kiciye hal ficil. Ka soo jiid baloogyada sanduuqa qalabka. Adeegso tifaftiraha foomka si aad u hesho xulashooyinka horumarsan.
r-blocks-discard: Ma tuuraysaa isbeddellada baloogyada ee aan la kaydin?
r-blocks-unavailable: Xogta xeerka lama heli karo. Adeegso tifaftiraha foomka si aad dib ugu eegto xeerkan.
r-blocks-invalid: Ku xir si sax ah hal kiciye hal ficil. Ka saar baloogyada aan ku xirnayn ama dheeraadka ah ka hor kaydinta.
r-blocks-conflict: Xeerkan wuu isbeddelay intii aad wax ka beddelaysay. Dib u soo rar xeerka la kaydiyey ka hor intaadan kaydin.
r-blocks-permission: Oggolaanshaha maamulaha sabuuradda ayaa loo baahan yahay si wax looga beddelo xeerarka.
r-blocks-reload: Dib u soo rar xeerka la kaydiyey
scrum-source-customField: Goob tiro ah oo la habeeyey
scrum-policy-dueComplete: Kaar lagu calaamadeeyey inuu dhammaystiran yahay
scrum-policy-doneLists: Kaar ku jira liis ka tirsan qaybta Dhammaystiran
scrum-edit-sprint: Samee ama wax ka beddel wareeg shaqo oo qorshaysan
scrum-releases-select-help: Kaar wuxuu ku jiri karaa dhowr sii-deyn. Qabo Ctrl (Cmd haddii aad isticmaalayso Mac) si aad u doorato wax ka badan hal; ka saar dhammaan doorashooyinka si kaarka looga saaro sii-deyn kasta.
scrum-select-sprint: Dooro wareeg shaqo si aad u aragto warbixintiisa.
scrum-backlog-help: Shaqada u kala hor mari darajada shaqooyinka sugaya. Kaararka u qoondee wareeg shaqo oo qorshaysan ama socda.
scrum-no-closed-sprints: Ma jiro kayd xaaladeed oo wareeg shaqo oo xiran.
scrum-report-help: Warbixinnadu waxay hayaan qiyaasaha ku jira kaydka xaaladda wareegga shaqada. Qiyaasaha aan la garanayn si gaar ah ayaa loo tiriyaa; ma aha qiyaaso eber ah. Isbarbar dhig xawaaraha waxqabadka keliya marka halbeegyada qiyaasta iyo xeerarku isku mid yihiin.
scrum-total: __count__ kaar; __estimate__ la qiyaasay; __unknown__ aan la garanayn
scrum-confirm-close: Ma xiraysaa wareeggan shaqada oo ma kaydinaysaa natiijooyinkiisa? Kaararka aan dhammaan waxaa loo wareejin doonaa meesha la doortay.
scrum-confirm-cancel: Ma baajinaysaa wareeggan shaqada? Kaararkiisu waxay ku sii jirayaan wareeggan ilaa meel kale loo qoondeeyo.
scrum-partial-report: Warbixin qayb ah: waxaa ku jira keliya kaararka hadda laguu qoondeeyey.
scrum-import-reference-omitted: Tixraac isha xogta ah dib looma soo celin karin: __reference__
scrum-partial-snapshot: Wareeggan shaqada wuxuu ka kooban yahay qayb keliya oo kaydkii xaaladda asalka ahaa ah.
scrum-resume-close: Sii wad xiritaanka wareegga shaqada ee hakaday
scrum-rollover-progress: Kaararka sprint-ka ayaa horay loo wareejinayaa: __done__ ka mid ah __total__
scrum-history-job-running: Isbeddel weyn ayaa laga noqonayaa ama dib loo samaynayaa: __done__ ka mid ah __total__ saf ee taariikhda
scrum-history-job-failed: Ka noqoshada ama dib u samaynta isbeddel weyn ayaa joogsatay. Mar kale riix ka noqo ama dib u samee si aad u sii waddo:
scrum-daily-observations: Baaxadda shaqada iyo shaqada hadhay maalin kasta (indha-indhayn)
scrum-daily-observations-help: Tiir kastaa wuxuu muujinayaa indha-indhayntii ugu horraysay ee la diiwaangeliyey maalinta UTC, waqtiga lagu muujiyey. Maalmaha maqan waa laga tagaa. Indha-indhayntani ma diiwaangeliso isbeddel kasta mana muujiso wadarta dhammaadka maalinta. Qiyaasaha aan la garanayn ma aha eber. Adeegso amarka Soo saar ee qaybtan si aad u dhoofiso indha-indhaynta maalinlaha ah; amarka Soo saar ee qaybta qalabku wuxuu dhoofiyaa natiijooyinka wareegga shaqada.
scrum-daily-truncated: Waxaa la muujinayaa keliya 366-ka indha-indhayn ee ugu dambeeyey.
scrum-daily-empty: Wax indha-indhayn maalinle ah looma diiwaangelin wareeggan shaqada.
scrum-scope-history: Baaxadda shaqada iyo shaqada hartay, isbeddel kasta
scrum-scope-history-help: Waxaa dib looga dhisay taariikhda sabuuradda tan iyo markii sprint-ku bilaabmay: saf kasta wuxuu u taagan yahay isbeddel ku yimid kaararka sprint-ka, qiyaasaha ama shaqada la dhammeeyey.
scrum-scope-history-inconsistent: Taariikhdu dib uma soo saarayso sawirka xaaladda sprint-kan u gaarka ah: isbeddellada qaarkood waxaa la sameeyey iyada oo aan taariikhda lagu qorin, sidaas darteed qiimayaashani ma dhammaystirna.
scrum-scope-history-truncated: Kaliya isbeddelladii hore ayaa la akhrin karay; dib-u-dhisku ma dhammaystirna.
scrum-scope-history-empty: Ma jiraan isbeddello tan iyo markii sprint-ku bilaabmay.
scrum-scope-cause-scrum: Ka mid ahaanshaha sprint-ka ayaa isbeddelay
scrum-scope-cause-lifecycle: Kaarka waa la kaydiyey ama dib loo soo celiyey
scrum-daily-observations-export-help: Indha-indhayntii ugu horraysay ee la diiwaangeliyey maalin kasta oo UTC ah; maalmaha maqan waa laga tagaa. Indha-indhayntu ma diiwaangeliso isbeddel kasta ama wadarta dhammaadka maalinta. Qiyaasaha aan la garanayn ma aha eber.
scrum-import-pending: Soo dejinta Scrum ma dhammaystirna. Wax ka beddelka Scrum iyo dhoofinta warbixinnada lama heli karo.
scrum-import-discard: Ka noqo soo dejinta aan dhammaan
scrum-import-recovery-hint: Soo dejin uu hakiyey dib u bilaabid ayaa halkan lagu dhammaystiri karaa marka ay istaagto. Haddii qorshaheeda aan si buuxda loo kaydin, waxa keliya oo laga noqon karaa; tani waxba kama beddelayso sabuuradda.
scrum-import-into-board: Qorshaynta Scrum ku soo geli sabuuraddan
scrum-import-into-board-hint: Dooro dhoofinta sabuurad WeKan ama faylka wareejinta Scrum. Sprint-yada iyo sii-deynaha sabuuraddan hore ugu jiray waa la xiriiriyaa, marna lama nuquliyo. Kaararka waxaa la waafajiyaa aqoonsiga ID, ama lambarka iyo cinwaanka kaarka; kaararka aan la waafajin waxaa lagu muujiyaa liiska waxaana loo daayaa iyagoo aan la beddelin. Marka hore eeg horudhaca si aad u aragto waxa isbeddelaya.
scrum-import-invalid-file: Faylkani ma aha JSON sax ah.
scrum-import-preview-sprints: Sprint-yo: __created__ cusub, __matched__ hore ugu jiray sabuuraddan, __skipped__ aan la soo gelin
scrum-import-preview-releases: Sii-deyno: __created__ cusub, __matched__ hore ugu jiray sabuuraddan, __skipped__ aan la soo gelin
scrum-import-preview-cards: Kaarar: __updated__ la cusboonaysiinayo, __unchanged__ aan isbeddelin, __unmatched__ aan la waafajin
scrum-import-preview-nothing: Wax la beddelo ma jiro: sabuuraddan hore ayay u lahayd qorshayntan.
scrum-import-into-board-done: Qorshaynta Scrum waa la soo geliyey waxaana lagu diiwaangeliyey taariikhda.
scrum-import-card-ambiguous: Kaar ayaa u dhigma in ka badan hal kaar oo sabuuraddan ku jira: __reference__
scrum-import-card-on-another-board: Kaar ayaa sabuurad kale ka tirsan, waxaana loo daayey isaga oo aan la beddelin: __reference__
scrum-import-record-ambiguous: Sprint ama sii-deyn ayaa u dhiganta in ka badan hal shay oo sabuuraddan ku jira: __reference__
scrum-import-record-not-imported: Sprint, sii-deyn ama dhacdo lama soo gelin karin: __reference__
sync-conflict-hint: Dooro qiime isku dhac kasta. Isku-waafajintu waxay isku daydaa mar kale doorasho kasta ka dib. Waxba looma diro nidaamka isha xogta.
sync-conflict-refresh: Mar kale samee isku-waafajinta si aad dib ugu eegto qiimayaasha hadda jira.
sync-conflict-review-complete: Kaararka laguu qoondeeyey dib ayaa loo eegay. Wax isku dhac ah kama hadhin goobaha. Isku-waafajinta liiska oo dhan lama samayn.
sync-conflict-keep-mapping: Kaarkani wuxuu sii ahaan doonaa mid la isku waafajiyo
sync-conflict-detach: Nuqulka u hay kaar maxalli ah
sync-conflict-detach-hint: Ka saar keliya xiriirka isku-waafajinta ee nuqulkan. Waxa ku jira waxay ku sii jiraan WeKan.
sync-conflict-archive: Kaarar hoosaadyo firfircoon ayaa hor istaagay u gudbinta kaydka
sync-conflict-archive-hint: Shaygii isha xogta wuu maqan yahay, laakiin kaarar hoosaadyo firfircoon ayaa hor istaagaya u gudbinta kaydka. Kaarkan maxalli ahaan u hay adigoo ka saaraya xiriirkiisa isku-waafajinta. Kaararka hoosaadyada ah lama beddelo.
sync-conflict-creation: Samee kaar isku-waafajin oo beddel ah
sync-conflict-creation-hint: Kaarkii hore sidiisa u hay oo kaar isku-waafajin oo cusub ka samee liiskan. Isku dayada dambe waxay dib u adeegsadaan kaarka beddelka ah.
sync-preview-saved: Waxay ku salaysan tahay dejinta la kaydiyey. Isku-waafajinta hadda la sameeyo waxay mar kale soo qaaddaa oo hubisaa isha xogta.
sync-preview-unavailable: Kaydi isha isku-waafajinta ka hor intaadan codsan hordhac.
sync-preview-blocked: Xalli isku dhacyada hoose ka hor intaadan dib u eegin qorshaha isbeddellada.
sync-preview-truncated: Waxaa la muujinayaa 100-ka diiwaan ee ugu horreeya.
sync-preview-scope: Tirooyinku waxay ku saabsan yihiin goobaha isha xogta ee qaabkooda la mideeyey. Barnaamijka fasira isha xogta wuxuu ka tegi karaa xog dheeraad ah.
sync-preview-excluded: Waxaa reebay xulashada goobaha ee la kaydiyey
sync-preview-parser-unsupported: Waxyaabaha laga tegay ee barnaamijka fasira xogtu sheegay
sync-source-heading: Goobaha isha xogta ee aan si toos ah loo koobiyeyn
sync-source-scope: Waddooyinku waxay isu geeyaan soo noqoshada goobaha ee shayada isha xogta. Walxaha aan xiriir loo samayn waxaa loo soo sheegaa iyagoo dhan; qiimayaashooda lama muujiyo.
sync-source-excluded: Waxaa reebay xulashada goobaha ee la kaydiyey
sync-source-converted: Waxaa loo beddelay qoraal ama qaab kale
sync-source-fallback: Qiime kale oo uusan adeegsan barnaamijka fasira xogtu
sync-source-excluded-item: Shay uu reebay barnaamijka fasira xogtu
sync-source-occurrences: Soo noqoshada goobaha ama shayada ee la soo sheegay
sync-source-truncated: Warbixintu waxay ku kooban tahay 100 waddo iyo magacyo goobeed oo la soo gaabiyey.
sync-source-omitted: Soo noqoshooyin dheeraad ah oo ka baxsan waddooyinka la muujiyey
sync-report-retention: 20-kii isku-waafajin ee ugu dambeeyey. Warbixinnada waxaa la hayaa 30 maalmood.
sync-report-partial: Isku-waafajinnada fashilmay ama aan dhammaan waxaa dhici karta inay beddeleen kaararka qaarkood. Warbixinnadani ma sii wadaan mana ka noqdaan isku-waafajin.
sync-report-unfinished: Socda ama hakaday; natiijada lama diiwaangelin
sync-report-failed: Fashilmay; isbeddello qayb ah way dhici karaan
sync-report-completed-with-warnings: Dhammaystiran iyadoo goobo laga tegay ama la beddelay
sync-report-unavailable: Warbixinnada isku-waafajintu waxay u baahan yihiin oggolaansho wax-ka-beddelka liiska oo dhan iyo adeege la heli karo.
sync-recovery-description: Warbixinnada isku-waafajinta ee la hayey 30-kii maalmood ee ugu dambeeyey. Ku raadi aqoonsiga sabuuradda ama liiska. Natiijo aan dhammaan waxay noqon kartaa hawl weli socota ama hakaday. Cusboonaysii si aad mar kale u hubiso; warbixinnadani ma sii wadi karaan mana ka noqon karaan isbeddellada.
sync-recovery-unavailable: Lama akhrin karo xogta baaritaanka isku-waafajinta. Hubi oggolaanshaha maamulaha iyo helitaanka adeegaha.
sync-estimate-field: Goobta qiyaasta Jira ee xiriirka loo sameeyey
sync-estimate-field-hint: Dooro goob tiro ah oo leh aqoonsi goobeed Jira iyo halbeeg qiyaaseed, sida ay samayso soo dejinta Jira ee xiriirrada leh. Isbeddellada maxalliga ah waxaa loo eegaa isku dhacyo ahaan. Qiimayaasha ka maqan isha xogta waa la iska dhaafaa; null si cad loo bixiyey wuxuu tirtiraa qiimaha goobta xiriirka loo sameeyey.
sync-estimate-field-gitlab-hint: Miisaanka ama qiyaasta waqtiga ee GitLab waxaa lagu qoraa goobta tirooyinka ee aad doorato. Isbeddellada maxalliga ah waxaa loo eegaa khilaafyo; arrin aan miisaan lahayn waxay tirtirtaa qiimaha ku xiran.
email-recovery-description: Hal saf ayaa u gaar ah qaata kasta. Ku raadi aqoonsiga isticmaalaha. Nuxurka farriinta iyo meelaha iimaylka qaataha lama muujiyo. Hakad geli waxay haysaa farriimaha hadda jira iyo kuwa mustaqbalka; Sii wad waxay hadda dib u tijaabisaa dirista farriimaha safka ku jira. Baaji waxay tirtirtaa farriimaha safka la geliyey ilaa waqtiga codsiga. Haddii diristu mashquul tahay, wax yar ka dib isku day mar kale. Farriin durba la dirayo dib looma soo celin karo, diris aan natiijadeeda la hubinna waa la celin karaa. Fashilaadaha joogtada ah iyo farriimaha gaadhay xadka isku dayada waxay u sii furnaanayaan dib u eegis. Dib u tijaabinta farriimaha fashilmay waxay bilowdaa wareeg cusub oo isku dayo ah, waxayna ilaalisaa hakadkii hore u jiray.
email-recovery-attempts: Tirada ugu badan ee isku dayada soo noqnoqda
email-recovery-oldest: Markii ugu horraysay ee safka la geliyey
email-recovery-empty: Ma jiraan farriimo safka ku jira ama qaateyaal diristooda la hakiyey.
email-recovery-unavailable: Safka iimaylka lama akhrin karo. Hubi oggolaanshaha maamulka iyo helitaanka adeegaha.
email-recovery-busy: Diris ama hawl kale oo safka ah ayaa socota. Cusboonaysii oo wax yar ka dib isku day mar kale.
email-recovery-failed: Hawsha lama xaqiijin karin. Cusboonaysii safka oo ku celi isla hawsha haddii loo baahdo.
email-recovery-superseded: Hawl cusub oo hawlwadeenku sameeyey ayaa beddeshay codsigan. Xaaladda hadda ee safka ayaa la muujinayaa.
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Ma la baajiyaa dhammaan farriimaha hadda safka ugu jira qaatahan? Nuxurkooda waa la tirtiri doonaa oo dib looma soo celin karo. Farriimaha cusub ee la abuuro codsigan ka dib waa la haynayaa.
email-recovery-attention: Waxay u baahan tahay fiiro gaar ah
email-failure-smtp-temporary: Diidmo SMTP oo ku meel gaar ah
email-failure-smtp-authentication: Xaqiijinta aqoonsiga iimaylka waxay u baahan tahay fiiro gaar ah
email-failure-smtp-configuration: Dejinta iimaylka waxay u baahan tahay fiiro gaar ah
email-failure-recipient-unavailable: Qaataha lama heli karo ama akoonka waa la damiyey
email-failure-delivery-unconfirmed: Gaarsiinta lama xaqiijin karin; dib u eeg ka hor intaadan mar kale isku dayin
email-failure-retry-limit: Waxaa la gaaray xadka isku dayada tooska ah
sync-time-estimate-hint: Qiyaasaha waqtigu waxay adeegsadaan goobaha tirooyinka waqtiga asalka ah iyo waqtiga hadhay ee ay samayso soo dejinta Jira. Sabuuraddan waa inay ku jirtaa hal goob oo keliya oo ku habboon. Wax ka beddelka maxalliga ah waxaa loo eegaa isku dhacyo ahaan; qiimayaasha ka maqan isha xogta waa la iska dhaafaa, null si cad loo bixiyeyna wuxuu tirtiraa qiimaha.
sync-planning-hint: Sprint-ka iyo sii-deynaha waxaa la isku waafajiyaa oo keliya marka Scrum ka shaqaynayo sabuuraddan. Sprint ama sii-deyn maqan ayaa lagu abuuraa sabuuraddan iyadoo la adeegsanayo taariikhaha ishu bixiso; mid hore u jiray waxaa marka hore lagu waafajiyaa aqoonsiga ID ee isha, ka dibna magaca. Isbeddelka qorshaynta ee maxalliga ahi wuu sii jiraa ilaa ishu beddesho qorshaynta hawshaas. Isku-waafajinta koowaad marna ma tirtirto qorshaynta.
activity-recovery-description: Ogeysiisyada aan dhammaan si toos ah ayaa mar kale loo isku dayaa. Dib u eeg hawlaha maqan ama isbeddelay ka hor intaadan mar kale isku dayin. Isku dayga dambe marnaba dib uma abuuro hawl.
activity-recovery-empty: Ma jiraan ogeysiisyo hawleed oo sugaya.
activity-recovery-unavailable: Ogeysiisyada hawlaha ee sugaya lama soo rari karin.
activity-recovery-status-missing: Hawshii asalka ahayd way maqan tahay
activity-recovery-status-invalid: Xogta sharaxaysa soo kabashada waa khaldan tahay
activity-recovery-status-inconsistent: Qorshaha iyo hawsha sugaysa isma waafaqaan
activity-recovery-busy: Hawlwadeen kale ayaa gacanta ku haya ogeysiiskan. Cusboonaysii oo mar kale isku day.
activity-recovery-denied: Oggolaanshaha qaataha ama doorbidyada ogeysiiska hadda ma oggola gaarsiinta.
activity-recovery-source-unavailable: Hawshii asalka ahayd way maqan tahay ama way isbeddashay. Waxba dib looma abuurin.
activity-recovery-failed: Gaarsiinta ogeysiiska lama dhammaystiri karin. Shaqadii sugaysay waa la hayaa.
activity-recovery-paused: Gaarsiinta ogeysiisyada hawlaha waa la hakiyey.
activity-recovery-control-conflict: Ogeysiiskani wuu isbeddelay tan iyo markii la soo raray. Dib u eeg xaaladda la cusboonaysiiyey ka hor intaadan mar kale isku dayin.
activity-recovery-control-failed: Dejinta gaarsiinta lama xaqiijin karin. Cusboonaysii oo dib u eeg xaaladdeeda hadda.
activity-recovery-status-cancelled: Gaarsiinta ogeysiisyada hawlaha waa la baajiyey.
activity-recovery-cancel-confirm: Ma si joogto ah ayaad u baajinaysaa gaarsiinta ka hadhay hawshan? Dib looma sii wadi karo. Iimayllada hore safka loogu daray iyo ogeysiisyada la gaarsiiyey dib looma soo celiyo.
rule-email-recovery-description: Dib u eeg isku dayadii la diiwaangeliyey ee dirista iimayllada xeerarka. Isku dayada aan la xaqiijin waxaa laga yaabaa inay weli socdaan ama ay hakad galeen. Ku fur mid "Dib u eeg" si aad dib ugu dirto, ugu calaamadiso in la diray ama aad ka saarto.
rule-email-recovery-invalid: Xogta qeexaysa isku dayga ma saxna
rule-email-recovery-empty: Ma jiraan isku dayo diris iimayl oo xeerarka ah oo ku habboon raadintan.
rule-email-recovery-unavailable: Isku dayada iimaylka xeerka lama soo rari karin. Cusboonaysii si aad mar kale isugu daydo.
rule-email-recovery-actions-hint: WeKan waligiis iskiis dib uguma diro iimayl aan la xaqiijin. Marka dib loo diro, wuxuu u tagaa oo keliya qaateyaasha aan la xaqiijin. Ku calaamadee in la diray haddii aad ogtahay inuu gaaray, ama ka saar.
rule-email-recovery-wait: Diristii hore weli way socon kartaa. Waxaad go'aansan kartaa ka dib __time__.
rule-email-recovery-resends: Dirisyadii ku celiska ahaa ee hore: __count__
rule-email-recovery-resend: Dib ugu dir qaateyaasha aan la xaqiijin
